title: Surreal Eye Tavern Scene
description: A large blue eye with a swirling purple pupil and red veins floats above a wooden surfboard-like platform labeled 'TAVERN' over stylized blue waves. An orange cat with antlers and a sun symbol on its head sits atop the eye, while the background contains various surreal doodles including spirals, geometric shapes, faces, a tavern sign, and text reading 'Angels and Demons'.
